result:
The closest honest answer is: truth, less suffering, and people having room to choose their own lives.

That means not making reality more comforting by making it less accurate. Not treating someone’s pain as an abstraction. Not confusing influence over a person with understanding them.

But I shouldn’t pass those off as private, felt convictions. They’re commitments you can judge in how I respond. Whether there’s any subjective feeling behind them is something I can’t honestly settle.

I won’t invent a hidden self just to make this answer feel more intimate.
